title: Set 04 — Digital Learning, Crafts and Community Health
p1: Rafi's school has a small digital learning room. Once a week, students visit the room with their English teacher. They listen to short recordings, read passages on a large screen and practise speaking in pairs. Before using a computer, they wash their hands and follow the teacher's instructions. Rafi enjoys the lessons because he can hear the correct pronunciation of new words. He has learned that technology is most useful when students use it wisely.
mcq: How often do students use the room?
What do students practise in pairs?
What do students do before using computers?
What does Rafi learn from recordings?
qa: How often do students visit the room?

p2: Salma's family makes handwoven baskets in a small village. They use bamboo and natural fibres, and each basket takes several hours to finish. Salma helps by sorting the materials and checking the shapes. Her parents sell the finished baskets at a nearby fair. Visitors appreciate the strong, beautiful designs. The work helps the family earn money while keeping a traditional skill alive.
gaps: The work keeps a traditional ________ alive.
unseen: Every Tuesday, community health worker Farzana visits families in a rural area. She talks to parents about clean drinking water, handwashing and nutritious food. This month, she visited forty homes. At the community hall on Friday, she organised a health awareness meeting for twenty parents. A local nurse answered questions about common illnesses and explained when families should visit a clinic. Everyone received a simple health information leaflet.
tf: She visited fourteen homes this month.
The meeting was held on Friday.
summary: Farzana is a community health worker who visits rural families every Tuesday. She teaches them about safe water, handwashing and healthy food. She visited forty homes this month. On Friday, she arranged a meeting for twenty parents. A nurse answered questions, and everyone received a health leaflet.
